## Sanitized Disposition

The scientific owner does not approve the proposed tolerance-conditioned
algorithm as normative SCI-NOI mechanics. Selection and justification of the
exact finite randomized design are delegated to the future implementation-
blind scientific-contract author, subject to every owner-approved ODQ-102A/B/C
boundary and claim restriction.

The author may adopt, revise, or reject the following nonbinding suggestion:

1. use the dimensionless network-local imbalance
   `Delta_h = abs(sum_{d in h} s_d B_d) / sum_{d in h} B_d`;
2. generate symmetric randomized candidates independently within each network;
3. accept a candidate only when every network meets an explicitly requested
   tolerance;
4. keep tolerances user-selectable with no inferred value;
5. bind a deterministic versioned counter-based generator and finite retry
   cap;
6. fail closed rather than silently relax an unmet tolerance; and
7. force neither complement pairs nor detector-count balance, while retaining
   duplicates and realized rank as design facts.

The author shall state the selected imbalance functional, tolerance semantics,
candidate/design law, key and algorithm identity, requested/resolved member
count, failure behavior, member dependence, complement/replacement treatment,
equivalence, duplicate handling, rank, effective-information consequences,
and rationale. It shall preserve complement symmetry and marginal detector
sign probability `1/2`, network-local coefficient balance, exact
reproducibility, fail-closed missing authority, and honest non-independence and
source-imprint limits. If the author cannot select defensible exact mechanics
from the admitted packet, it shall return one precise scientific question.

This is authority to author a proposal, not advance owner acceptance of its
eventual bytes. No numerical design becomes available until the exact Stage B
contract is returned, reviewed, and accepted through the ordinary scientific-
contract process.
